title: .wittyplay file, version 1
description: How games are pictured in a games front end: box art fitted or filled, or drawn in a cartridge or case. Open specification: docs/specs/wittyplay-file.md. This schema is dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0).

wittyplay.description: The format's version. This schema describes 1.

generator.description: The program that wrote the file, for people reading it.

consoles.description: A look per console, by console id.

look.description: How pictures are shown at one level. Every field is optional; an absent one is decided by the level above.

picture.description: fitted: the whole box art over a blurred, dimmed copy of itself; filled: the box art fills the tile, cropped; case: drawn in a cartridge, disc case or the like.

case.description: The case drawing, when picture is case. auto lets the console decide. A reader that doesn't know a style draws the console's own.

label.description: What goes on a case's label: the box art, the game's logo picture, or its title in type.

match.description: Which game an entry is for. Every field given must agree. item is one server's own id.
